note.question: How much reshoring capacity should a global firm build when future demand and trade policy are uncertain and a domestic rival competes in the destination market?
note.overview: The paper embeds a Cournot product-market equilibrium in a multistage capacity and production-location game under tariff or tax uncertainty.

models.method: The paper formulates a three-stage tariff model reflecting firms’ operational decisions in different phases: the global firm’s long-term decision on how much reshoring capacity to install.
